2. The facts involved in the case, in short, are that the suit land appertaining to C.R. Khatian No. 3 originally belonged to Ramgoti Nomo. Thereafter, upon an amicable family settlement Girish Chandra Nomo got .32 acres of land in Dag No. 235 Girish Chandra died leaving behind his only son Nogendra Nomo as his only heir who got the said property and S.A. record was prepared in his name. Thereafter, Nogendra transferred .05 acres of land Out of .32 acres to Siddiqur Rahman by a registered kabala deed dated 24.08.1996 and .04 acres of land to Rahima Khatun by a registered deed dated 24.08.1996 and the Nogendra transferred 21 acres of land to the defendant No. 1, Tajul Islam and Abul Basher by registered kabala deed dated 24.08.1996. The defendant No. 1, Nasiruddin got .07 acres of land on the western side of the Dag No. 235. Thereafter, Siddiqur Rahman, Rahima Khatun, Tajul Islam and Abut Bah transferred their .23 acres of land to the plaintiff by a registered kabala deed dated 20.06.1998. The plaintiff has been possessing the said property by erecting pucca house and then principle, Aminul Islam instituted Title Suit No. 130 of 1999 in respect of Dag No. 235 and the plaintiff was defendant. No. 4 in that suit and during pendency of that suit the defendant No. 1proposed to sale his share of the suit property his necessary of money and the plaintiff agreed to purchase it and they settled the matter in Modina Engineer Workshop on 12.11.1999 in the presence of Md. Humayun Nurul Huq and Selim and consideration money was fixed TK. 75,000.00 and it was also settled that the plaintiff gave TK. 50,000.00 to the defendant No. 1 as bai.na and the defendant will deliver possession of the suit land in favour of the plaintiff and the persons present in the sitting expressed that the bainapatra may create problems due to the pendency of the suit instituted by the Principal, Ardinul Islam and then the plaintiff paid TK. 50,000.00 to the defendant No. 1 and the defendant. No. 1 handed over possession of the property to the plaintiff. Thereafter, the plaint of the Title Suit No. 1 30 of 1999 was taken back on 21.11.1999. Thereafter, the plaintiff requested the defendant to execute the kabala deed by taking the balance' consideration money that is TK. 25,000.00 but the defendant No. 1 refused to do so and lastly on 31.12.1999 the defendant refused to execute the kabala deed in favour of the plaintiff and then the plaintiff instituted the suit against the defendant. 

 3. The defendant No. 1 contested the suit by filing written statement contending, inter-alia, that the defendant purchased .078 acres of land in Dag No. 235 by a registered kabala deed dated 24.08.1996; that the Dag No. 234 is situated on the northern side of the defendant's property the land of Abu Basher is on the southern side, Road is on the ease side and the land of the is on her name in mutation Khatian No. 629. Mier institution of the Title Suit No. 104 of 1998 by the Principal, Amirul Islam the defendant handed over all responsibility in respect of the suit upon Siddiqur Rahman and Siddiqur Rahman came to Dhaka and took the signature of the defendant in a plain cartridge paper for purpose of preparing written statement in Title. Suit No. 130 of 1999. Thereafter, the defendant came to know that Siddiqur Rahman and others created a bainapatra on that: plain paper by conspiracy with the plaintiff and Tajul Islam and others by mentioning the boundary of the defendant's property created a kabala dated 30.06.1998 in favour of the plaintiff. The defendant stated that he neither made bainapatra with the plaintiff nor he handed over possession of the suit land in favour of the plaintiff and the fact of taking TK. 50,000.00 by the defendant is false and as such the Suit of the plaintiff is liable to be dismissed.
